    [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace ℝ N]

    ContDiffAt n f x ↔ 
    ContinuousAt f x ∧ 
    ∀ (P : Type*) [TopologicalSpace P] [ChartedSpace ℝ P] (g : P → M),
      Manifold.IsImmersion g → 
      (∃ y, g y = x ∧ ContDiffAt n (f ∘ g) y) := sorry
